evidenceKinds.sharedSemantics: Run actual core and paired shipped bridges; exact full document, origin, history, save/receipt comparisons
evidenceKinds.hostInteraction: Real native/browser input, composition, focus, pointer/touch/keyboard recording
evidenceKinds.rendering: Original captured pixels with runtime/theme/viewport/font settings
evidenceKinds.assistive: Real named assistive tool navigation/actions, not inferred from render/tree
evidenceKinds.physicalInput: Real device/IME/keyboard/focus recording; simulator qualification kept distinct
evidenceKinds.physicalPerformance: Raw traces, actual hardware/runtime, measured timings and explicit threshold decision
